en: Group challenges you run: dates, what is measured and the prize. Entries, finishers, finish rate, average improvement and the winner fill in by themselves from Challenge Entries.
cur: 你举办的挑战赛：日期、测量内容和奖品。参赛人数、完赛人数、完赛率、平均改善幅度和获胜者会根据挑战赛报名记录自动填充。

en: Check the Injuries sheet and swap restricted exercises
cur: 检查伤病表并替换受限动作

en: Add the restriction on the Injuries sheet
cur: 在伤病表上添加限制

en: Log every exercise of every session on Workout Log with sets, reps, load and effort. Estimated max and new records work themselves out.
cur: 在锻炼记录上记录每次训练的每个动作，包括组数、次数、负重和发力程度。估算最大重量和新的个人纪录会自动计算。

en: Add the client and exercise to Records and Plateaus to follow a lift. Its flag shows progressing, plateau, slipping or not trained lately.
cur: 将客户和动作添加到“记录与平台期”，以跟踪动作进展。标记会显示进展中、平台期、下滑或近期未训练。

en: Add every injury on Injuries with the pattern to avoid. Any logged session that breaks the rule turns the alert red.
cur: 在伤病表中记录每项伤病及应避免的动作模式。任何违反规则的训练记录都会使警报变红。

en: Run challenges on Challenges and Challenge Entries: results give the improvement, rank and winner.
cur: 在“挑战赛”和“挑战赛记录”中开展挑战赛：结果会显示进步幅度、排名和获胜者。

en: Money and Coaches
cur: 资金和培训师

en: Average margin of the packages on your Price List
cur: 价目表中套餐的平均利润率

en: Type the cash you hold and your monthly money in and out; see the gap, how many months the cash lasts and how the 12-week forecast on the Cash Forecast sheet compares with your minimum.
cur: 输入持有的现金以及每月的现金流入和流出；查看资金缺口、现金可支撑的月数，以及“现金流预测”工作表中的12周预测与最低要求相比如何。

en: Enter every cost on Expenses with its tax rate
cur: 在费用中输入每一项成本及其税率

en: Pay the renewal fee and record it on Expenses
cur: 支付续费并在费用中记录

en: Fill Team and Credentials: one row for each coach and helper with cost and price per hour, weekly hours and the dates their certificate, first aid and insurance end.
cur: 填写“团队和资质”：为每位教练和助手填写一行，包括每小时的成本和价格、每周工作小时数，以及证书、急救资质和保险的到期日期。

en: Enter refunds and credit notes on Refunds and Credits. They come off income and tax in the monthly profit sheet.
cur: 在“退款和贷项”表中输入退款和贷项凭单。它们会从月度利润表的收入和税金中扣除。

en: Every month enter the hours each coach worked on Coach Hours and Pay. Pay, cost per session, utilisation and margin per hour follow.
cur: 每个月在“教练工时和薪酬”表中输入每位教练的工作小时数。薪酬、每课时成本、利用率和每小时利润会随之显示。

en: Record every cost on Expenses with its tax rate, set the monthly budget for each category on Budgets and list your equipment with its useful life on Equipment. Depreciation flows into the monthly profit.
cur: 在“费用”中记录每项支出及其税率，在“预算”中为每个类别设置月度预算，并在“设备”中列出设备及其使用寿命。折旧会计入每月利润。

en: Read the Money Dashboard and Charts each week to see profit, ageing, deferred revenue, cash and utilisation at a glance.
cur: 每周查看资金仪表盘和图表，快速了解利润、逾期账款账龄、递延收入、现金和利用率。

en: Read Fill by Hour for the heat map of the week and Team and Hours for each coach's load and free slots in the next 7 days.
cur: 查看“按小时上座率”了解本周热力图，并查看“团队和工时”了解未来 7 天内每位教练的工作量和空闲时段。

en: Log every incident, near miss, hazard and equipment fault on Incident Log with an action and a due date, and keep first aid, emergency and facility checks on Safety Checks.
cur: 在事故记录表中记录每起事故、未遂事故、危险隐患和设备故障，并注明处理措施和截止日期；在安全检查表中记录急救、应急及设施检查情况。

en: Keep classes, workshops, challenges and events on Classes and Events, supplier and partner details on Contacts, and client scores on Reviews to see your recommendation score.
cur: 将团课、工作坊、挑战赛和活动记录在“课程和活动”表中，将供应商和合作伙伴信息记录在“联系人”表中，并将客户评分记录在“评价”表中，以查看推荐指数。
